related_resources.reason: Nonlinear boundary-value examples and energy estimates.
Uniform convergence from equicontinuity and boundedness.

authorship.scope: Original audio-first lecture and mathematical companion on nonlinear minimax, Palais–Smale compactness, explicit semilinear existence, or critical exponent scaling; inherited manuscripts are unchanged.

prerequisites.reason: Know the theorem and the Palais–Smale requirement.
Know the weak Dirichlet problem and the first-variation integral.
Know compactness and Sobolev inequalities in the one-dimensional setting.

recommended.reason: Review function norms, basic Hilbert-space ideas and weak limits.
Connect stationary nonlinear boundary problems to introductory differential equations.

background: Single-variable critical points, basic multivariable derivatives, integration by parts, function norms and weak solutions; the new path-minimax arguments are developed from examples.
readiness_checks: Use the cancellation identity J(u) minus one quarter of its derivative on u to bound the slope norm of almost-critical sequences.
Compute the sine-path maximum and the reason uniform convergence permits the cubic limit.
